justification: Insufficient Modularization not indicated: in `byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/dynamic/ClassFileLocator.java` (lines 115-147), `Resolution.Illegal` is a tiny nested sentinel with one field (`typeName`), one constructor, and only two behavioral methods (`isResolved()` always returns false; `resolve()` only throws `IllegalStateException`). It has a single responsibility as the canonical unresolved-resolution representation and no evidence of multiple cohesive concerns or excessive method/field count.
